games.name: Kebab Battles 🍖
games.desc:
OFFICIALLY RELEASED 10 MARCH, 2025

🔥A silly fighting game made by a silly (handsome) man where you run around stabbing people with skewers to craft a very delicious kebab. Earn credits and unlock cool new skewers with cool new abilities.

😎Join the group (https://www.roblox.com/communities/35504080/kebab-party) for codes, upcoming updates and other cool announcements.

Controls (also listed at the top of your screen)
------------
Stab
> PC: Click
> Mobile: Tap
> Console: RT / R2

Ability
> PC: Q
> Mobile: Button
> Console: LT / L2

Eat
> PC: E
> Mobile: Button
> Console: X / Square
------------

Exploiter? Type '/votekick whoever' in chat to create a server vote, please also report them in the community.
